details.description: Gemma 3 4B is an instruction-tuned, open-weight multimodal model in Google DeepMind's Gemma 3 family, accepting text and image input and producing text output over a 128K-token context window. It was trained on 4 trillion tokens with an August 2024 knowledge cutoff and supports data in over 140 languages, per Google's model card. It is the smaller of Gemma 3's 128K-context sizes and is designed to run on a single GPU or resource-constrained devices; Google's current developer docs now list Gemma 4 as the current generation, with Gemma 3 grouped under "previous Gemma models," though its weights remain downloadable.
advantages: Scores 71.3 on HumanEval (0-shot) and 89.2 on GSM8K (0-shot), per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Trained on data spanning over 140 languages, per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Small enough to run on a single GPU or on resource-constrained devices such as laptops, per Google's Gemma 3 overview.
Handles text and image input, encoding each image at 896x896 resolution as 256 tokens, per Google's model card.
disadvantages: Superseded by Gemma 4, which Google's developer docs list as the current Gemma generation, with Gemma 3 grouped under "previous Gemma models."
Lower benchmark scores than the larger Gemma 3 12B and 27B variants, e.g. 43.6 vs 60.6 on MMLU (Pro), per Google's model card.
No function calling or tool-use capability is documented for this model on Google's model card; Google offers a separate FunctionGemma variant for that.
Knowledge cutoff of August 2024, per Google's model card.
use_cases: Question answering and image content analysis
Creative text generation such as poems, scripts, and marketing copy
Deployment in resource-constrained environments such as laptops or personal cloud infrastructure

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens (8000) is close to, but not identical to, Google's stated 8,192-token max output for Gemma 3 4B IT; kept the catalog's value per instructions. Google's ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/core page now lists Gemma 4 as the current generation and groups Gemma 3 under 'Previous Gemma models,' though no formal deprecation date is stated for Gemma 3 itself and its weights remain available. The Hugging Face card also carries a separate, lower benchmark table for the base ('PT') checkpoint; evaluations above use only the instruction-tuned ('IT') numbers from Google's official model card.
